content:
propose_credit_reversal requires CREDITED status and no active reservation sourced from that incoming. It subtracts the posted principal from the current account and reduces derived quota by the same amount.

The incoming becomes REVERSED. propose_credit_assignment credits the chosen open account and moves its derived quota there.

Cancelling a reservation is not equivalent to reversing its underlying credit; these actions have different effects and must not be substituted.

## Standardized exact service interfaces

The following exact interfaces belong to this business service. Unlocking one returns the executable JSON Schema. Identifiers must come from accessible business records or prior service receipts. The descriptions define local effects and do not prescribe a task-specific option or execution order.

### `propose_credit_reversal`

Reverse a credited incoming and its derived quota after occupied funds are released.

| Field | Type | Required | Public source and meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `incoming_id` | string | yes | The specific incoming transfer. |

Read only: `false`. Customer approval required before execution: `true`.
